1. Navigate to a manual expense created with default attendee selected
2. Click on the "Attendee" row
3. Uncheck the selected "Attendee" by clicking the green checkmark
4. Verify At lease one attendee must be selected error message displayed
5. Verify the "save" button is disabled
6. Select any other user as "Attendee"
7. Verify the error message no longer displayed and "save" button enabled
8. Click on the "Save" button
9. Verify the "Attendee" list is displayed as per selection
10. Verify a system message is displayed as changed the attendees to xyz (previously 123)

Title: (HOLD - New TC)Import Contacts - Special Characters/Emojis in Names, No-names and Duplicate Contacts
Steps:
1. Launch the Expensify app
2. Go to FAB > Create expense > Scan
3. Take a photo or select an image
4. On the soft permission modal to import your contacts, tap "Continue"
5. On the native modal, tap the option to allow access to the device contacts
6. Verify the native modal closes
7. Verify contacts appear in the participant/recipient list
8. Verify contacts with no name are displayed only as the phone number or email
9. Verify duplicate contacts only appear once in the list
10. Verify contacts with special characters/emojis in their names are displayed correctly without corruption or rendering issues
11. Search for a contact using their name, including special characters/emojis
12. Verify the search accurately finds the contact
13. Select the contact.
14. Verify the app handles interactions with this contact normally

Title: (HOLD - New TC)Import Contacts - Revoke Permission Post-Approval
Steps:
1. Go to device settings for the Expensify app
2. Revoke the contacts permission
3. Force-quit/kill the Expensify app
4. Relaunch the Expensify app
5. Navigate to a feature that requests contact access (e.g., Create expense > Scan > Take a photo > Recipient list)
6. Verify the app does not crash
7. Verify a fallback UI is displayed (e.g., an empty contact list or a prompt to enable permissions) instead of imported contacts
8. Go to device settings for the Expensify again and enable the contact access for Expensify
9. Open the Expensify app
10. Verify contacts are reloaded and displayed correctly

Title: (HOLD - New TC)Import Contacts - Toggle iOS Contacts Settings
Steps:
1. Go to iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Contacts
2. Find Expensify and disable the contacts access
3. Open the Expensify app
4. Navigate to a feature that displays contacts (e.g., Chat search)
5. Verify contacts are no longer visible, or a message indicating permission is denied is shown
6. Go back to iOS Settings > Privacy & Security > Contacts
7. Enable the contact access for Expensify
8. Open the Expensify app
9. Verify contacts are reloaded and displayed correctly

Title: Exposed filters options
Steps:
1. Navigate to the Reports page
2. Verify that there are exposed filters for type, status, date and from
3. Click on the "Advanced filters"
4. Verify the "Type" filter always appears at the top of the General section in Advanced filters
5. Click on the "Type" filter
6. Verify the "Type" filter is a single-select filter and default to "Expense"
7. Verify the "Invoice" option is only displayed to users when it is enabled in the workspace settings, and hidden when it is not
8. Select any other "Type" options  (Chat)
9. Verify Clicking the "Reset" button changes the selected Type back to "Expense"
10. Verify that changing the Type filter resets the Status and GroupBy filters.
11. Verify that changing the Type filter also changes the selected menu item in the LHN (i.e. Expenses -> Chats or Chats to Expenses)
12. Verify the status options in the Status change based on the selected Type filter
13. Click on the "Type" filter and select "Expense"
14. Click on the "Save" button
15. Verify the following options are displayed in status filter (Unreported, Drafts, Outstanding, Approved, Paid and Done)
16. Click on the "Type" filter and change from "expense" to "chat"
17. Click on the "Save" button
18. Verify the following options are displayed in status filter (Unread,sent,Attachments,Links and Pinned)

6. Continue with plaid credentials
7. Choose the savings account "Plaid Saving11122XXXXXX111"
8. Complete the Personal info / DOB / Address step

10. Continue with Company info steps and Click "Confirm"
11. Complete Business owner steps by selecting "No" for all the questions
12. Checkmark all the options in Complete verification step
13. Click "Save & Continue" button
14. Verify *Let's finish in chat" modal displayed with the following options "Finish in chat", "Update details", "Start over"
15. Click "Finish in chat" push row

17. Verify the following message is displayed Possible Restricted Business Hi there, Our records indicate that your company may be involved in the marijuana industry. Due to our current policies, we are unable to support direct payment processing for businesses in this category, and your business bank account will not be connected to Expensify.
18. Navigate back to "Connect bank account" modal
19. Click "Continue setup"
20. Verify Let's finish in chat modal displayed
21. Click "Update details"
22. Click "Next" without changing any details until Name of your company step
23. Update the company name to "Alberta Bobbeth Charleson"
24. Click "Next" without changing any details until Complete verification step
25. Click "Save & continue"
26. Verify there's a success modal (You're all set!)
27. Click the back arrow in the modal
28. Verify the modal is dismissed
29. Verify the bank account is displayed in workspace settings as added
